name: 朝阳永续-AI-A股多维筛选
description_zh: 朝阳永续A股自然语言多维筛选技能，覆盖基本面、财务、估值、行情、资金、公告事件、主题概念和专业标签，支持多条件及历史结果追加筛选。
description_en: Suntime A-Share Screener supports natural-language stock screening across fundamentals, financial metrics, earnings forecasts, valuation, market data, capital flows, announcements, corporate actions, themes, and professional labels. Use it for multi-condition A-share searches, follow-up filtering, and screening based on previous results.
